label: A demonic covering over the royals, and darkness around the president
description: An antichrist spirit and darkness seen trying to overshadow the president on the Sunday, which he says he could not see through until the King arrived that week, and a statement that there is a demonic covering over the royals while explicitly not calling the King the antichrist. He says he did not know the visit was coming; state visits are announced well in advance.

label: Israel, not America, makes the Iranian mountain glow
description: The mountain in Iran will be made to glow in the days ahead but it will not be America that does it, it will be Israel, using a tactical weapon of a kind never seen before, and afterwards it cannot be claimed as an American action. Naming which of the two acts is the checkable part, and he stakes it plainly.
